notes.title: v2.1 changelog
notes.notes:
v2.1 is now live!


Fixed: The initial warning screen now correctly understands the position of the mouse cursor.
Fixed: Lexy no longer frowns throughout the entire VANQUISH scene.
Fixed: Portraits no longer have minor artifacting at sizes other than 2×.
Fixed: Cerise no longer preserves momentum when the time changes.
Fixed: The credits now mention software libraries we used and their licenses, which Valve wouldn't let us link on the store page anywhere.
Fixed: Dialogue no longer crashes when two transitions happen on the same frame (only possible in a hidden game mode).
Fixed: Don't crash when reading the dev commentary about the engine, as hilarious as that is.
Fixed: A couple minor details in the dev commentary were wrong.
Fixed: Removed a backup copy of portraits.png, which added a meg and a half of garbage.


Remaining known issues:


In very rare cases, the game logs your dialogue choices incorrectly and doesn't unlock starting from a later day.  I don't know why yet.
One player has gotten a WinSxS error when trying to start the game, and had to delete the .manifest file manually.  I suspect this is a configuration problem with their machine, but can't be sure; please let me know if you run into this.
Save files are per Windows user, not per Steam user.  I will almost certainly never fix this.  Sorry!
Due to Microsoft hegemony, button assignments for objectively correct Nintendo-style controllers are incorrect.  This is a massive headache because controllers don't report what's written on the physical buttons, so the only way to know for sure is to somehow make a big list of every controller ever made.  Wow, game development is terrible!
